generator: scratchpad gen.py (not committed); regex import/URL extraction + hand-reviewed overrides

domains.shared-i18n: Locale loading, t()/useI18n, language selector. Cross-cutting; migrate first (T25 shared wave).
domains.shared-auth: Session validation, login, auth gate, forced password change, 401 redirect policy.
domains.shared-data-query: fetch wrappers, @preact-signals/query adapter, request queue, async action hook.
domains.shared-ui-primitives: Toast system, modal/dialog primitives, AsyncButton, loaders, image helper.
domains.shared-shell: Header/Footer/navigation, theme, setup wizard, sentry, generic utils and settings cache.
domains.streams: Streams admin list/edit pilot (T11/T19-T22) plus create/delete/bulk/ONVIF flows and ZoneEditor.
domains.live: Unified Live view (PR #691), video transport cells, PTZ/day-night/overlays, operator navigator/plans.
domains.recordings: Recordings list/grid/table, filters, batch delete/download, playback helpers.
domains.settings: Settings page and tabs (general, storage, detection, go2rtc, auth, MQTT, health, workspaces...).
domains.system-health: System page, logs, storage/network/system health, health view/incidents.
domains.users-access: Users, roles, access policy, API tokens, TOTP, audit history.
domains.fleet: Fleet inventory, organizations/tags/locations, collections, saved views.

generated_untracked_modules.note: gitignored, produced by scripts/extract_version.* ; imported by Header.jsx. Not in rg --files.

auth_failure_redirect.note: fetch-utils.js owns handleAuthenticationFailure()/401 redirect inside enhancedFetch/fetchJSON; every consumer of fetch-utils (direct or via query-client re-export of fetchJSON) inherits auth redirect behavior.

toast.note: Two toast modules exist. ToastContainer.jsx is the live system (rendered by every page). Toast.jsx (ToastProvider/useToast) has no importers in web/js or tests: orphan candidate for T25/T34.

modal.note: UI.jsx re-exports ConfirmDialog from common/ModalDialog.jsx and owns ModalProvider/VideoModal/SnapshotPreviewModal plus imperative showVideoModal/showSnapshotPreview (dynamic import of preact).

zone_editor.note: ZoneEditor is only consumed by StreamConfigModal (Streams edit). It loads/saves /api/streams/{name}/zones and snapshot frames via /go2rtc/api/frame.jpeg. DetectionOverlay (Live) reads the same zones route independently. zone-editor-geometry.js is shared with DetectionOverlay conventions (see zoneEditorGeometry.spec.js).

query.note: query-client.js wraps @preact-signals/query: useQuery(key,url,fetchOpts,queryOpts), useMutation, usePost/Put/DeleteMutation(url), QueryClientProvider/queryClient singleton, and re-exports fetchJSON. Every page entry wraps its tree in QueryClientProvider.

orphans.note: Not reachable from any HTML entry via static/dynamic imports. Toast.jsx has no importers at all.

api_paths_exercised: GET /api/system/info returns system info and version summary
POST /api/auth/users stores bare IP login restrictions as single-host CIDRs
POST /api/auth/users/{id}/login-lockout/clear clears a user login lockout

esbuild external/stub keyed by filename suffix: i18n.js

config_and_tooling.detail: testMatch '**/tests/**/*.spec.js' and transform '^.+\.jsx?$' only: .ts/.tsx specs/modules are neither discovered nor transformed.
Babel config used by Jest; several specs note it has no JSX transform, hence esbuild bundling in tests.
files globs 'js/**/*.js','js/**/*.jsx' and 'js/components/**/*.{js,jsx}' (i18n rule): TS/TSX would not be linted.
Looks up web/i18n-literal-baseline.json by path relative to web/js/components/ including extension; a .jsx->.tsx rename loses the allowance (lint fails) or needs a new key (T10).
Each HTML page references ./js/pages/<page>.jsx by literal path in <script type=module src>.
reads js/utils/theme-init.js by literal path at build time (COLOR_THEMES injection).
projects match /.*\.api\.spec\.ts/, /.*\.ui\.spec\.ts/, /.*\.go2rtc\.spec\.ts/. No file matches the go2rtc project (go2rtc.api.spec.ts runs under 'api').
generate web/js/version.js (gitignored; imported by Header.jsx as ../../version.js).

explicit_extension_imports.note: Every unit/integration test that imports app code uses an explicit-extension relative specifier (e.g. ../js/utils/x.js). Any .js->.ts or .jsx->.tsx rename must update these specifiers or keep a JS re-export shim (plan convention).

i18n_literal_baseline.keyed_by: path relative to web/js/components/ including .jsx extension

schema_consumers.note: No OpenAPI/JSON-Schema artifacts exist in the repo (docs/api/*.md is prose only). Current "schemas" are implicit: UI response normalizers and locale catalogs. Planned contract artifacts (docs/api/openapi.yaml etc.) are produced by T11/T12.

live_compatibility_pr691.source: PR #691, merge 1b8d4332, commit 42ed026d "Merge LiveView and WebRTCView into one Live component (#654)"
live_compatibility_pr691.component: web/js/components/preact/LiveView.jsx exports LiveView({variant, audioDisabled, isAutoDisabled, isWebRTCDisabled, isHlsDisabled, isMseDisabled}); WebRTCView.jsx was deleted and must not be recreated (plan assumption).

variants.defined_in: web/js/utils/live-view-url.js LIVE_VIEW_VARIANTS; unknown variant falls back to hls; LiveView default prop variant="hls"

entry_behavior.web/index.html -> web/js/pages/index-pag: Fetches /api/client-config and /api/setup/status in parallel; variant = resolveLiveViewVariant({webrtcDisabled}) => "hls" when webrtc_disabled or go2rtc_enabled===false, else "webrtc". Renders SetupWizard if setup incomplete. Header/ToastContainer/Footer rendered inside AuthGate at page root.
entry_behavior.web/hls.html -> web/js/pages/hls-page.js: Fetches /api/client-config only; always variant="hls". Header/ToastContainer/Footer rendered inside App (after flags load) rather than at root.

live_compatibility_pr691.transport_resolution: resolveForcedLiveTransport(pathname, search, {autoDisabled, offerings}): ?mode=webrtc|mse|hls wins; else pathname ending /hls.html forces "hls"; else when Auto disabled pick first offered of webrtc,mse,hls; else null (per-stream configured chain).
live_compatibility_pr691.transport_tabs: getLiveTransportTabs(): auto -> /index.html (no mode), webrtc -> /index.html?mode=webrtc, hls -> /hls.html, mse -> /hls.html?mode=mse (only if go2rtcAvailable && !mseDisabled). Covered by web/tests/liveViewTransportTabs.spec.js and web/tests/liveViewUrl.spec.js.
live_compatibility_pr691.persistence_compat: localStorage keys are prefixed per variant (webrtc-* vs hls-*) to preserve pre-merge user layout/selection state; react-query key differs per variant (webrtc-summary vs live-summary). Changing either is a user-visible compatibility break.
live_compatibility_pr691.client_config_field_read_quirk: index-page.jsx reads camelCase (audioDisabled, webrtcDisabled, go2rtcEnabled...) before snake_case; /api/client-config only emits snake_case so camelCase branches are dead. hls-page.jsx reads snake_case only.
live_compatibility_pr691.data_source: LiveView loads cameras through fetchAllStreamSummaries({surface:"live"}) => GET /api/streams?summary=true&surface=live paged at 100.
